brief:
Abdalkareem Issa Ahmed Safi, a teenager with Texas roots, is being held in Israeli custody, according to Zeteo. The outlet reports he is being detained in what it describes as a notorious jail facility. His case adds to concerns about the treatment of American citizens held by Israeli authorities.

The detention comes amid broader scrutiny of Israel's detention practices and U.S. policy responses to cases involving American detainees.
dek: Abdalkareem Issa Ahmed Safi has Texas roots but languishes in a notorious jail, one more victim of Benjamin Netanyahu’s cruel impunity. Donald Trump, meanwhile, is losing some of his most ardent fans.
title: Israel detains American teenager in custody without charges
